metadata.description: Agent skills by Shahar Shavit for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Agent-Skills-compatible harnesses

plugins.name: shaharsha-skills
plugins.description: All 19 agent skills - gdoc-sync, gslides-sync, gsheets, presentation-generator, narrating-pptx, deck-to-video, self-presenting-decks, brand-system, brand-assets, image-generation, prompt-engineer, writing-project-instructions, tech-design-doc, namecheap-domains, office-render, viewing-videos, proton-pass, excalidraw-diagrams, tavily-extract

plugins.name: documents-and-decks
plugins.description: Sync Markdown to Google Docs, .pptx to Google Slides, CSV / values to Google Sheets, generate AI-rendered 16:9 presentation decks, add per-slide ElevenLabs voice narration with autoplay to any pptx, turn narrated decks into self-playing mp4 videos, and orchestrate the whole deck-to-narration-to-video chain

plugins.name: brand-and-visuals
plugins.description: Author production-grade brand books, run logo / favicon / icon-pack pipelines, generate AI imagery via gpt-image-2 and Gemini Nano Banana, and build architecture / flow / system diagrams in Excalidraw

plugins.name: engineering-decisions
plugins.description: Author technical design review documents - RFCs, ADRs, design docs, KEPs, and partner-mode TDRs

plugins.name: building-agents
plugins.description: Expert prompt-engineering reference for AI agents on Claude, GPT, and Gemini APIs, plus authoring CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md project-instruction files

plugins.name: utilities
plugins.description: Domain availability via Namecheap API; rendering Microsoft Office files (.docx/.pptx/.xlsx) to PDF/images via the real Office apps on macOS; viewing video files (mp4/mov) by extracting the fewest frames that answer the question; managing credentials and secrets via the Proton Pass CLI (pass-cli); plus fetching JavaScript-rendered or bot-blocked web pages that WebFetch can't, via the Tavily Extract API
